name: Rehabilitation
overview: Scripture reveals that true rehabilitation begins with a cleansing from sin and a turning away from evil, as God commands His people to wash themselves and cease their wrongdoing. This process involves divine refinement through trials, not for destruction but for purification and selection. God promises to transform the heart, replacing the hardened, unresponsive nature with a new, tender spirit. Furthermore, mutual confession and fervent prayer within the community are vital for healing, underscoring the power of righteous intercession in the restoration of both soul and relationships.
